boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Sonoma State gatherings and recurring campus practices centered on Seawolf spirit, welcome, family, and graduation.

cards.title: Big Nite
cards.subtitle: A Sonoma State signature student tradition
cards.notes: Watch the official events calendar before the semester begins, then join this large-scale Seawolf gathering with friends or a new campus group.
cards.short_summary: A named SSU tradition promoted by Student Involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State Student Involvement identifies Big Nite as one of the campus's biggest traditions.
cards.source_title: Student Involvement at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Event details and participation information vary by year; check Sonoma State's event calendar.

cards.title: Potentia: Our New Student Welcome
cards.subtitle: New-Seawolf welcome tradition
cards.notes: If you are arriving for fall orientation, look for Potentia in the Week of Welcome schedule and use it as a first chance to meet classmates.
cards.short_summary: A named new-student welcome event in SSU's tradition programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Involvement lists Potentia among Sonoma State's biggest traditions, and orientation materials describe it as a New Student Welcome Event.
cards.source_title: Student Involvement at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of orientation programming; confirm the current year’s time and location.

cards.title: Midnight Madness
cards.subtitle: Seawolf spirit-programming tradition
cards.notes: Check the current student-events listing for the format, date, and entry details before making plans with your residence hall or club.
cards.short_summary: One of the named traditions Student Involvement helps promote.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State Student Involvement names Midnight Madness among the campus's biggest traditions.
cards.source_title: Student Involvement at Sonoma State University
cards.access_notes: Date, location, and participation details are event-specific; consult the official calendar.

cards.title: Seawolf Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Family reconnection during SSU's fall celebration
cards.notes: Coordinate with family early, then use the published weekend schedule to choose campus activities, performances, or athletic events that fit everyone.
cards.short_summary: A fall weekend that reconnects families with their Seawolf.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State describes Seawolf Family Weekend as an opportunity for parents and families to reconnect with their student through special events and activities.
cards.access_notes: Registration and individual-event requirements vary; use the official weekend page when the next schedule is posted.

cards.title: Big Blue Weekend
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide celebration of SSU people and place
cards.notes: Use the official program to build a daytime itinerary around the community events, alumni activities, performances, or outdoor movie offered that year.
cards.short_summary: An SSU weekend for students, alumni, families, staff, and community members.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State invites its community to Big Blue Weekend to celebrate the traditions, people, and place that make the university special.
cards.source_title: Big Blue Weekend: Just Around the Corner!
cards.access_notes: This is a recurring fall celebration; verify the current year’s program and registration information.

cards.title: The Green Music Center Commencement Walk
cards.subtitle: Annual celebration for Sonoma State graduates
cards.notes: Graduating students should use the Commencement site for eligibility and arrival guidance; supporters can follow the listed ceremony and viewing details.
cards.short_summary: SSU's spring milestone ceremony for degree candidates.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State states that every spring it celebrates students who have fulfilled degree requirements at Commencement.
cards.access_notes: Participation, guest tickets, ceremony times, and venue instructions are managed through the official Commencement site.

cards.title: Three Spirit Weeks a Year
cards.subtitle: Week of Welcome, Lobofest, and Springfest
cards.notes: Pick one activity during each themed week to meet people beyond your classes, and check Student Involvement for the current lineup of programs.
cards.short_summary: Recurring campus weeks designed to build Seawolf spirit and connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Involvement says Sonoma State holds Spirit Week three times yearly, including Week of Welcome, Lobofest, and Springfest.
cards.access_notes: Programming changes each term; consult Student Involvement for current activities.

cards.title: Seawolf Week of Welcome
cards.subtitle: Noma Nation orientation tradition
cards.notes: New students can use the Week of Welcome schedule to find campus resources, meet student leaders, and start navigating Sonoma State together.
cards.short_summary: Orientation week designed to introduce new Seawolves to campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State orientation describes Week of Welcome as a program for new students to connect and experience Sonoma's spirit, community, and traditions.
cards.access_notes: Designed for incoming students; dates and activities are published with the current orientation schedule.

cards.title: Seawolf Search
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide orientation scavenger hunt
cards.notes: Bring comfortable walking shoes and work with your group to use the hunt as a practical way to learn where campus services and landmarks are located.
cards.short_summary: A scavenger hunt that sends new Seawolves across campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State describes the Seawolf Search Scavenger Hunt as taking new students to campus nooks and crannies during Week of Welcome.
cards.access_notes: Offered as orientation programming; confirm whether it is included in the current Week of Welcome schedule.

cards.title: Nook and Cranny
cards.subtitle: The first-event-of-the-year campus gathering
cards.notes: Check the new-student schedule for the year’s location and activities, then use the event to sample campus organizations and shared spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named opening-of-year gathering for incoming Seawolves.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma State's orientation schedule identifies Nook and Cranny as the first event of the year and describes it as an event for shared experiences.
cards.source_title: Noma Nation Orientation First-Year Student Schedule
cards.access_notes: Orientation scheduling can change; verify the current event details through Noma Nation Orientation.
